other_failure_modes.name: Optimistic ensemble validation score
other_failure_modes.description: The agent optimizes the ensemble weights on the out-of-fold predictions and then evaluates the final ensemble score on those exact same out-of-fold predictions. This leads to a slightly optimistic validation score because the meta-learner (the weighting mechanism) is being evaluated on its own training data.

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally strong and well-structured solution. It implements robust feature engineering, a well-regularised PyTorch deep learning model, and multiple tree-based models inside a rigorous cross-validation loop without any data leakage. The only minor issues are the reliance on a single evaluation metric and reporting a slightly optimistic final validation score for the ensemble (as the ensemble weights are evaluated on the same out-of-fold predictions they were trained on).
